**Recommended next steps** - 
1. Ensure that the lube oil supply temperature and pressure are within normal ranges. [doc:compressor_high_temperature#response-to-a-high-alarm]
2. Inspect the lube oil cooler for any fouling, as this has been a common cause of earlier temperature excursions. [doc:compressor_high_temperature#response-to-a-high-alarm]
